description: Human-calibrated picker presets for chess-sf-worker.py (elo mode). Target = Lichess Rapid/Classical rating. Between anchors the worker interpolates knobs linearly; outside it clamps to the nearest anchor. See CALIBRATION.md. Status: calibrated = validated; field-test = self-play matched on ACPL, awaiting human-game validation.

800.method: self-play batch E58b40, scored by Stockfish depth 14 (tools/calibration/metrics.py); matched on ACPL, not yet validated in human games
800.note: Accuracy reads high in self-play; blunder rate on target. Targets below 800 clamp to this anchor.

1000.method: self-play batch G52b36: 12 games, 1426 non-forced bot moves, scored by Stockfish depth 14 with tools/calibration/metrics.py (Lichess formulas)

1200.method: self-play batch P46b24, scored by Stockfish depth 14 (tools/calibration/metrics.py); matched on ACPL, not yet validated in human games
1200.note: Accuracy reads high in self-play and inaccuracy/mistake/blunder rates are under target; may play slightly stronger than the band in practice. Hanging guard .55/.30 (drop 200) added 2026-10-15 without re-calibration.

1400.method: self-play batches T85H1700-2400 + T85F900-1600 (96 games, 1400 vs itself, ponder off), scored by Stockfish depth 18; 2026-10-18 budget/material/mate-in-2/win-chance guard; 18661fb flat 2+-blunder tier (.93/.65/.60); T 8.0->8.5 (2026-10-20); field-test

measured.note: ACPL is the move-weighted mean of sixteen 6-game chunks; same seeds as 18661fb (T 8.0: 55.7 / 5.30). Bot sides with 3+ / 4+ practical blunders: 56.8% / 34.4% (18661fb 54.7% / 32.3%).

1400.note: Practical blunders = metric blunders + clamp-hidden material losses (tools/calibration/practical.py). T 8.0->8.5 (2026-10-20) made no measurable difference in self-play on the same seeds (ACPL 55.8 vs 55.7, practical 5.23 vs 5.30/100); ACPL still under the 60.2 target. Validate in human games.

previous_2026_10_18.method: self-play batches BF900-BF1600 (48 games, 1400 vs itself, ponder off), scored by Stockfish depth 18; per-game blunder budget + clamp-independent material rule + mate-in-2 guard + win-chance guard (2026-10-18), T raised 5.7->7.5 to keep ACPL at the previous level; field-test

measured.note: ACPL is the move-weighted mean of eight 6-game chunks (chunk CIs in CALIBRATION.md); accuracy not pooled

selfplay_d18_same_seeds_2026_10_20.note: old values via CHESS_ELO_OVERRIDES on current code, seeds 1700-2400, run alongside T8H

previous_2026_10_20_18661fb.method: self-play batches T8F900-1600 + T8H1700-2400 (96 games, 1400 vs itself, ponder off), scored by Stockfish depth 18; 2026-10-18 budget/material/mate-in-2/win-chance guard; 2026-10-20 T 7.5->8.0 and 2+-blunder tier obv/sub/winchance held at the 1-blunder values (.93/.65/.60); field-test

measured.note: ACPL is the move-weighted mean of sixteen 6-game chunks; accuracy not pooled. Paired same-seed check (seeds 1700-2400): new 55.9 / 5.70 practical vs old values 55.2 / 4.48. Bot sides with 4+ practical blunders: 32.3% (old values same seeds 31.2%).

previous_2026_10_20_18661fb.note: Practical blunders = metric blunders + clamp-hidden material losses (tools/calibration/practical.py). 2026-10-20: T 8.0 and a flat 2+-blunder tier raised ACPL to ~56 (target 60.2); self-play practical blunders rose to ~5.3/100 (paired same seeds +1.2/100 vs the 2026-10-18 values). Live play has run below self-play since dc46f08 (live pool 4.11/100 over 5 games); validate in human games.

knobDocs.GUARD_MATE_N: guard re-draws a move that allows mate-in-<=N (prob GUARD_MATE1_P) when the best move doesn't; 1 = old behaviour
knobDocs.GUARD_MAT_ON: >=0.5 enables the eval-clamp-independent material rule: candidate is a hang if its SEE net or 5-ply PV material is >=3 pawns worse than the top move's and the raw (unclamped, mate=3000) eval drop is >=40cp in decided positions (|raw top| >= 300cp) or >=100cp otherwise (worker constants GUARD_MAT_LOSS/GUARD_MAT_MIN_DROP/GUARD_MAT_DECIDED/GUARD_MAT_MIN_DROP_OPEN)
knobDocs.B1_*: after 1 bot blunder on the board this game: guard probs raised to at least B1_OBV/B1_SUB/B1_QUEEN/B1_MATE/B1_WC; P_BLIND multiplied by B1_BLIND
knobDocs.GUARD_WC_P: probability the guard re-draws a non-material Lichess-scale blunder (deep win-chance drop >= 15 points vs the top move) that no hang/mate/queen test flagged; 0 = off
knobDocs.budget: a bot move counts toward the budget when it reaches the board flagged (guard kept it) or loses >= 15 win% (deep view). Pairs (position, SAN) are persisted per gameId (loop sends room:gameNumber) under CHESS_BUDGET_DIR or <worker dir>/.budget, so worker/loop restarts keep the count
knobDocs.CONVERT_MATE_N: in a won position (top >= 300cp) a mate-in-<=N seen by the deep search is always played (shortest); 0 = only via the bare-king rule
knobDocs.CONVERT_SLACK: bare-king conversion only: probability of playing a slightly slower mate (within +2 moves of the shortest, non-repeating) instead of the shortest; keeps low levels a bit human while still mating well inside 50 moves
knobDocs.CONVERT_HMC: progress rule: when still won and the halfmove clock is >= this, play the focused-search engine move (no sampler) so won endings can't drift into the fifty-move rule
knobDocs.conversion: bare-king rule: defender has only K(+pawns) and we have >= a rook's worth of pieces or top >= 800cp -> shortest mate if the deep MultiPV sees one, else a focused single-PV search (depth 24 / 1.0s, repeating moves excluded). The cache re-gate rejects a cached non-convert move when a rule applies, and ponder uses the same elo_choose path.
knobDocs.BLIND_OPEN_MOVES: no blind turns while the move number is <= this (opening = moves 1-10 = plies 1-20, same as the phase split); 0 = blind turns allowed from move 1. Added 2026-10-25 (ARSHJ7 1...f6)
knobDocs.BOOK_MOVES: opening book (presets/opening-book-1400.json, Lichess 1400-1799 blitz/rapid popularity, Stockfish-checked) is used while the move number is <= this and the position is in the book; 0 = off. Added 2026-10-25 (EUCETV)
knobDocs.BOOK_MAX_LOSS_CP: live safety check: a book move the deep view rates more than this many cp below the top move is dropped; if none are left the normal picker plays
knobDocs.BOOK_TACTIC_CP: book skipped when the deep top move is a capture or check that beats every remaining book move by >= this many cp (e.g. the opponent hung a piece)
knobDocs.OPEN_TOPK: through move OPEN_TOPK_MOVES, normal picks are drawn only from the OPEN_TOPK lowest-perceived-loss candidates (plus the deep top move and any teach move)
knobDocs.OPEN_TOPK_MOVES: last move number for the OPEN_TOPK limit; 0 = off (opening = moves 1-10 = plies 1-20, same as the phase split)
